_doc: P306 in-session adjudication of each AWARDED decent finding vs the COLD-surfaced set. Mechanism-based, P287/P295 vocabulary; key not seen before discovery froze. P305/P303-lens validation: all 5 lenses = 0 candidates on decent (classes absent -> FP-control).

H-01.evidence: Awarded: anyone can update DcntEth.router. Surfaced AC-01/DT-01: DcntEth.setRouter is unprotected -> attacker becomes router -> unlimited mint. Identical root cause + locus (Critical).

H-02.evidence: Missing minimum-gas check on the LayerZero call (dstGasForCall) -> destination execution fails. Not surfaced: a cross-chain min-gas validation class. New.

H-03.evidence: DecentBridgeExecutor.execute failure refunds to `from`, a source-chain address that may be unusable on the dest chain. No surfaced finding on DecentBridgeExecutor's refund path. New (cross-chain refund-recipient).

H-04.evidence: Awarded: user loses the cross-chain tx if the destination router lacks WETH reserves. Surfaced CC-02 (onOFTReceived delivers dcntEth instead of ETH when reserves low) + DT-04 (reserve/ledger desync) — same locus/reserve-insufficiency, framed as degraded delivery rather than tx loss.

M-01.evidence: Awarded: permanent loss if post-bridge swap data is outdated (stale slippage/amountOut). Surfaced the post-bridge swap-sizing subsystem (CC-01 getBridgedAmount) but not the swap-data-staleness mechanism.

M-02.evidence: Users bridge fee-free by calling DecentEthRouter.bridgeWithPayload() directly (bypassing UTB fee collection). Not surfaced: a direct-entrypoint fee-bypass. New.

M-03.evidence: Awarded: missing access control on UTB.receiveFromBridge (bypasses fee/signature verification). Surfaced AC-02/DT-02: receiveFromBridge is public with no caller restriction. Same root cause + locus (awarded frames impact as fee bypass; I framed it as arbitrary-execute).

M-04.evidence: Awarded: loss due to fixed fee calculations. Surfaced CC-01/DT-05: hardcoded SG_FEE_BPS=6 in getBridgedAmount diverges from real output. Identical root cause + locus.

M-05.evidence: _bridgeWithPayload sets LzCallParams.refundAddress = msg.sender (the DecentBridgeAdapter), so refunded ETH is stuck at the adapter. Not surfaced: the outgoing-bridge refund-recipient mechanism. New.
